sloka: यदा तु रामस्य सलक्ष्मणस्य ।प्रसह्य सीता खलु पा इहाऽहृता ।सकृत्समीक्षैव सुनिश्चितम् तदा ।भजेत चित्तम् यमुनेव यामुनम् ॥६-१२-२८॥।।
transliteration: yadā tu rāmasya salakṣmaṇasya ।prasahya sītā khalu pā ihā'hṛtā ।sakṛtsamīkṣaiva suniścitam tadā ।bhajeta cittam yamuneva yāmunam ॥6-12-28॥।।

translations.english: "If you had at that time, that is before bringing Sita by force, which was accompanied by Rama and Lakshmana, discussed, and thought of, then you would be sure in your mind like the Yamuna River filling the Yamuna (mountain )."
